summary: Iteration 7 — full validation of the three reported issues: (1) SISBEN now shown by GROUPS (A-D) and LEVELS (A1-D21), (2) cascading filters with cross-clear (facultad→programa→materia), (3) DIVIPOLA includes international cities. ALL 10 backend tests and ALL 3 frontend scenarios PASS. The implementation matches the spec perfectly.
critical_code_review_comments: caracterizacion_router._group correctly filters out 'SELECCIONE...', 'SELECCIONE', 'NO REGISTRA' (line 75). Good defensive normalisation.
dashboards_router /filters builds facultad_programa via aggregation pipeline; values are sorted alphabetically and pulled from real student data (single source of truth). Solid.

AppLayout.setFilter (l.49-65) correctly cascade-clears `programa` if it is no longer present in the new facultad's program list, AND clears `materia` if `programa` changes. This logic uses the freshly fetched `opts.facultad_programa` map — works end-to-end.

FiltersPanel.programasFiltrados (l.205-207) gates the visible programa list on the selected facultad, so the UI cannot offer impossible combinations. Verified: selecting 'Ciencias Administrativas y Económicas' yielded exactly 8 programas in the dropdown.

Caracterizacion.jsx Socioeconómico tab (l.159-169) renders BOTH 'Grupo SISBEN (A–D)' and 'Nivel SISBEN (A1–D21)' charts as separate Blocks. Levels chart spans full row (lg:col-span-3) and uses height=320 for readability — good UX choice for ~30 categories.
Minor (non-blocking): /api/caracterizacion/overview latency is acceptable but could be cached at the (filters→result) layer if usage grows; currently re-runs ~30 aggregations per request.
